title: Fewer dead ends for chat clients and tools
summary:
A day of removing avoidable errors from chat, tools, and image generation, while making room for another community app.

OpenAI-compatible clients that append extra path segments can now reach chat completions instead of getting a 404. Gemini tool calls no longer fail when their schemas contain fields Vertex AI does not support. Model lookups also became case-insensitive, and DeepSeek V3.2’s registry ID was corrected.

A missing configuration that caused `gptimage-large` image generation requests to fail was added.

The Indonesian-language n8n-grok image generator joined the creative app directory. App submissions now get stronger duplicate checks before proceeding, with borderline matches flagged for review.
